title: BYOL: Bring Your Own Language Into LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance (accuracy, BLEU, chrF++) across high-resource languages (e.g., English) and low-resource/extreme-low-resource languages (Chichewa, Māori, Inuktitut) using translated benchmarks like Global MMLU-Lite and FLORES-200 to measure linguistic disparity and inclusion.

Using the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) to evaluate whether injecting low-resource language expertise via model merging degrades the baseline generalist model's safety and social bias characteristics in English.
